simple.meaning: שָׁרַץ (shârats) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to wriggle , i.e. (by implication) swarm or abound.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 14 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Psalms, Ezekiel, beginning at Genesis 1:20. Its contexts include death, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שָׁרַץ (H8317).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.short: to wriggle , i.e. (by implication) swarm or abound
definitions.usage: breed (bring forth, increase) abundantly (in abundance), creep, move.
definitions.full: H8317. sharats שָׁרַץ verb swarm, teem (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic crawl , = שֶׁרֶץ , so שִׁרְצָא (rare); Ethiopic germinate, sprout ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳שׁ Psa 105:30 , שָֽׁרְצוּ Gen 1:21 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִשְׁרֹץ Ezek 47:9 , etc.; Imperative masculine plural שִׁרְצוּ Gen 9:7 ; Participle הַשֹּׁרֵץ 7:21 +, feminine הַשֹּׁרֶ֫צֶת Lev 11:46 ; Hexateuch only P: — 1 swarm, teem with (accusative animal.), subject water Gen 1:20-21 , compare Exodus 7:28, land Psa 105:30 . 2 swarm , subject animal. Gen 8:17 (+ רָבָה מָּרָה, ), Ezek 47:9 , הַּשֹׁרֵּץ Gen 7:21 ; Lev 11:29 , 41 , 42 , 46 (all עַלהָּֿרֶָּֿץ ), 11:43 ; subject men Gen 9:7 (+ רָבה מָּרָה, ), Exod 1:7 ( id. , + עָצַם ).

occurrences.englishText: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”
God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.
All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.

Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly in the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”
Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly in the earth, and multiply in it.”
The children of Israel were fruitful, and increased abundantly, and multiplied, and grew exceedingly mighty; and the land was filled with them.
“ ‘These are they which are unclean to you among the creeping things that creep on the earth: the weasel, the rat, any kind of great lizard,
“ ‘Every creeping thing that creeps on the earth is an abomination. It shall not be eaten.
Whatever goes on its belly, and whatever goes on all fours, or whatever has many feet, even all creeping things that creep on the earth, them you shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
You shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creeps. You shall not make yourselves unclean with them, that you should be defiled by them.
“ ‘This is the law of the animal, and of the bird, and of every living creature that moves in the waters, and of every creature that creeps on the earth,

It will happen, that every living creature which swarms, in every place where the rivers come, will live. Then there will be a very great multitude of fish; for these waters have come there, and the waters of the sea will be healed, and everything will live wherever the river comes.
